info.name: StudyAnchor
info.description:
Demo data and checks for every functional requirement (FR-01..FR-12).

Run the whole collection top to bottom with the Collection Runner (or Newman). Folder 0 creates new user IDs
(alice-xxxx, bob-xxxx) each run, so the collection can be run again without restarting the services.

Needs: Kafka (docker compose up -d) and all four services running. Folders 10 and 11 call Gemini and need
LLM_API_KEY in .env; a 503 there means the LLM is unavailable or over quota: wait a minute and run the folder again.
Folder 2 uploads postman/sample-material.md: set Postman's working directory to the postman folder
(Settings > General), or pick the file in the request's Body tab.
